text: AI is changing how we think about creativity. Today, AI tools can create art, compose music, and even write stories or articles. You just give a simple instruction, and the machine produces something new in seconds. But is this real creativity? Humans create from emotions, memories, and personal experiences. AI, on the other hand, learns from existing data and finds patterns. It does not feel joy, sadness, or surprise. So while AI can copy styles and produce impressive results, true creativity still belongs to people. Perhaps the best future is when humans and machines work together.
